senses.example: Anoche discutí con mi hermano por una tontería.
senses.exampleGloss: Last night I argued with my brother over something silly.

alternatives.reason: Stronger and more emotional than discutir.
discutir also means to discuss calmly; comentar covers that sense.

notes: discutir con alguien = to argue with someone. The calm "discuss" sense exists but is less frequent in speech.
